name: Chorveth
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 11

Actions.name: Spore Thread
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Sundering Shove
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from Chorveth and has the Prone condition.

Traits.name: Nightmare Reek
Traits.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 14, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation originating from Chorveth. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.
Traits.expresses: hollow black spore pore in chitinous underside

lore: Chorveth is a scrap of a sleeping god's nightmare that took root in the damp fungal beds beneath a forgotten shrine, and it wants only to sleep again — which it can do only if other minds dream for it.

generation.cite: composition after Ogre (CR 2) — one colossal hit, no traits
